right.tested_scope: Reproduce-before-ablate attribution gate: withhold causal credit for an internal scientific mechanism/component until the claimed baseline is reproduced end-to-end under the official evaluation and isolated component mutations are tested against that reproduced baseline with verifiable artifacts. The cited support is system-level evidence from three computational virtual-cell repositories (CPA, GEARS, BioLORD): the source checkpoint reports 88.9% end-to-end workflow success and 93.3% recovery of ground-truth critical components. The same checkpoint explicitly limits the inference: abstract-level evidence does not isolate the causal contribution of reproduce-first versus mutation-graph search, so this supports the attribution workflow rather than a matched ablation of the gate itself.

overlap_dimensions: Both impose a verification gate before a consequential downstream commitment: reconcile durable external-effect state before execute/recertify on the left, and reproduce the baseline before assigning component-level causal credit on the right.
Both are designed to prevent a false inference caused by acting on incomplete state: duplicate external effects after process death versus false component attribution from system-level gains.
disjoint_dimensions: Execution substrate: crash-prone external-effect controller/provider state versus scientific repository reproduction and component-ablation attribution.

Control mechanism: durable intent, stable effect identity, provider reconciliation and immutable outcomes versus end-to-end baseline reproduction followed by isolated repository mutations and attribution checks.
Measured failure mode: duplicate or inconsistent external effects after process death versus granting causal credit to an internal mechanism that was never isolated from the full-system gain.

Primary evidence: exact execute/reconcile counts and certificate digest across six SIGKILL boundaries versus system-level reproduction/critical-component recovery metrics across three virtual-cell repositories.
Scope limits: constrained provider idempotency/reconciliation contract versus computational virtual-cell repositories with no matched ablation isolating reproduce-first from mutation-graph search.
comparison.material_difference: terminal_outer_sigkill_reference is executed process-death recovery evidence for suppressing duplicate external effects under a constrained provider contract. candidate_095 is a scientific attribution gate requiring baseline reproduction and isolated ablations before component-level causal credit. Their authoritative identities, tested scopes, interventions, metrics and failure modes are distinct, and neither scope subsumes the other.
